escalations.why: risk.Drawdown in docs/packages/risk/contract.md is 'ticker: str; depth: float; peak_date: str', but RISK-05 requires the date of the peak AND the date of the trough, REP-01 requires the report row to hold the drawdown and both dates, and tests/fixtures/risk/TC-08/expected.json expects a trough_date per drawdown (M1-T20 acceptance: 'both dates exact'). Freezing Drawdown as written leaves M1-T20 and M1-T10 unable to meet their acceptance. Proposed fix: add 'trough_date: str' to risk.Drawdown (invariant: peak_date <= trough_date; both the first date when there is no fall), then re-run M1-T01.
